text:
Maya Patel: Quick check-in: new idea to reduce noise in compare table -> introduce "compact badges" that show p95 only and expose p50/p99 on focus. Also proposing 'pin affinity' concept (pin scope clarity). Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-affinity-2412.png
Caleb Ortiz: Love the compact badge. Implementation note: prefer keyboard-focus reveal (role=dialog in popover) over hover-only.
Rhea Kapoor: About pin affinity: suggest three states: row-only, model-affinity (applies when pinned from model header), and global-default. Need microcopy to explain.
Kara Gomez: Accessibility nits: aria-description for pin toggle should say exact scope e.g., "Pinned: model-wide (v3.1.0)". Ensure contrast of pinned icon >= 3:1.
Maya Patel: Microcopy proposal: button label = "Pin"; on focus add sr-only text "Pin (model-wide)" or "Pin (row)" depending on context. Tooltip can expand on hover.
Caleb Ortiz: For filter chips ordering: prefer explicit user-order + a small 'restore default' action. Persist order in session/localStorage.
Rhea Kapoor: Export note: include a metadata header row when exporting snapshots: "# pin_affinity: model". That helps downstream analyses.
design-bot: Created RD-INF-5410 with owners: Caleb (badge popover), Rhea (export schema), Kara (a11y pass).
Maya Patel: OK, small PRs please. Re-share updated mock when ready :thumbsup:
